jobs.description:
At Toyota Material Handling Europe, we create the technology that keeps the world moving. Diverse businesses across Europe depend on our logistics and material handling solutions. By pioneering technology like automation, connectivity and productivity solutions, we enable our customers' logistics operations to be as efficient as possible. 
We firmly believe in setting ideas in motion. At Toyota Material Handling Europe, we are over 13,500 colleagues passionate about supporting companies of all sizes with todays and tomorrow's material handling challenges. Because we know that our business and our industry are essential and sometimes even critical for them, for daily life and society at large. 
In our respective headquarters in Mjölby, Sweden, Willebroek, Belgium, in our Sales companies across Europe, or in our factories in France, Italy and Sweden, you can be part of an extraordinary journey. And together, we will Move the world towards easy and sustainable. 
The Position 
We are looking for a Power BI Developer to join our Digital Business & Connectivity team as maternity cover from January 2027 to March 2028. You will build and maintain Power BI reports, act as third-line support for data and reporting issues and take on a range of other data-related work.
You will be part of a small, supportive team together with our data steward and data analyst, so you'll have experienced colleagues to learn from. This is a great opportunity to build real-world experience in a large international company. As you grow in the role, you can also take on customer-facing reports used by our customers across Europe.
Your Responsibilities 
Develop and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards for internal stakeholders, built on our Snowflake data platform
As you grow in the role, contribute to customer-facing reports embedded in our digital customer portal
Handle third-line support: triage incoming cases, investigate what's behind reporting and data issues, and route them to the right team
Work with stakeholders to understand their reporting needs
Test and verify changes before they reach production
Help keep our reports and data well documented, together with our data steward
Your Profile 
You love building reports that people actually use. You can explain what a star schema is in kindergarten language, you know your way around how data gets from source to report through ETL, and you'd rather dig into a strange number or graph than ignore it. You don't need years of experience. What matters is a solid foundation and the drive to keep learning. Meticulous approach to data accuracy and commitment to maintaining high-quality standards.
We'd like you to have:
Hands-on experience building Power BI reports, whether from work, studies, an internship or your own projects
A working knowledge of DAX and SQL
Good communication skills in English, with both technical and non-technical colleagues
A quick-learner mindset: you enjoy picking up new tools, frameworks and modelling concepts, and you're not afraid to ask questions
It's a plus if you have:
A degree or ongoing studies in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related field
A Power BI certification (e.g. PL-300)
Exposure to Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse
Experience with Azure DevOps or a similar agile work-tracking tool
Experience with Atlan or other data catalogue platforms
Your Application 
Send your application, CV, and Cover letter in Swedish or English, no later than 22nd of November. The position is to be based either in Mjölby or Gothenburg.
For more information regarding the recruitment process, please contact: Patrik Schultzén, Talent Acquisition Specialist, Patrik.schultzen@toyota-industries.eu 
We will review and contact candidates before the last application date.

As the Technical Project Lead, you’ll be the cornerstone of our project execution, owning the technical scope and driving success from the beginning to completion. You’ll act as the vital link between our internal team and customers, ensuring seamless communication, and technical excellence. Key responsibilities for the Technical Project Lead include:
Lead the technical execution of all waterjet projects, from planning to the end of warranty period
Translate customer needs into actionable technical requirements

·       Review and interpret technical specifications, documentation and applicable standards to ensure project requirements are correctly understood and implemented

What we think you should have
We’re looking for a skilled professional with experience in technical project management or design engineering—ideally within mechanical or industrial engineering. You’re confident managing multiple projects and priorities, and you approach problem-solving with creativity and determination. Your ability to stay organized and focused helps drive successful outcomes. Since we operate in an international context, strong English language skills are essential.
At KONGSBERG MARITIME, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!
Our ambition is to fill the position as soon as possible; selection and interviews may therefore begin during the application period. Why join us

 Kristinehamn, Sweden

Kongsberg Maritime is a technology pioneer, enabling a more sustainable future for our oceans. Our zero-emission integrated technologies advance the maritime industry and solve our customers' toughest problems. With unmatched competence, domain knowledge, innovation, and market reach, we are the trusted maritime partner. We don’t just build technology. We build hope for everyone dealing with Cancer.
Elekta is shaping the standard of care, together with healthcare providers, by developing precision radiation medicine that brings advanced radiotherapy into routine clinical practice. Our solutions support consistent, efficient and personalized care, addressing evolving patient needs. Through adaptive radiotherapy, precision treatment delivery and integrated workflows, Elekta supports care teams across a range of clinical settings. Each year more than 2 million patients are treated using Elekta solutions across over 130 countries. Elekta is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, with over 4,000 employees and offices in more than 40 countries. The company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. For more information, visit elekta.com.
What You’ll Do At Elekta
As a Group Business Controller, you will play a central role in our Group Business Control function, helping provide senior management with clear, reliable financial insights that support informed decision-making.
You will lead and coordinate group-wide planning and forecasting, analyse financial performance and key business drivers, and work closely with regions, business lines and the wider finance community. Through strong financial analysis and business partnering, you will help strengthen performance, improve the quality and consistency of reporting, and drive greater cost awareness across the Group.
Responsibilities
Coordinate the Group budget and forecast cycles, including consolidation, challenging assumptions and explaining changes in outlook.
Analyse and quality assure Group financial performance against budget, forecast and prior periods, identifying key revenue, margin, expense and cash drivers.
Lead performance reviews with regions and business areas, agree follow-up actions and track progress.
Prepare concise financial reports, insights and decision material for senior management and the Board of Directors.
Develop Group performance measures, reporting definitions and processes to improve consistency and comparability across the business.
Act as a finance business partner to senior stakeholders, providing analysis on costs, strategic initiatives, risks and opportunities.
Support a reliable monthly close and contribute financial analysis and quality review to interim, annual and other external reporting.
Partner with Finance and IT to improve financial BI applications, data quality and reporting processes.

What You’ll Bring
Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, industrial engineering or a similar field.
At least 5+ years of experience in financial analysis, business planning, forecasting and performance management.
Experience with financial reporting, consolidation, planning and BI systems.
Ability to translate complex financial information into clear, concise insights and decision material for senior stakeholders.
Strong stakeholder management and business partnering skills, with the ability to work effectively across regions, business lines and functions.
High attention to detail and sound financial judgement.
Ability to challenge assumptions constructively and turn financial analysis into practical recommendations.
A collaborative approach and the ability to build effective relationships across a global finance organisation.
Fluency in both English and Swedish is preferred.

What You’ll Get
30 paid vacation days per year.
4 additional Elekta days off.
Defined contribution pension scheme.
Private Medical Insurance.
Lunch Benefit.
Contribution to wellness activities.
A collaborative office environment four days a week, working alongside talented colleagues in a supportive and engaging workplace.

Application process
We look forward to receiving your application. Please submit your CV in English via the “Apply” button. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Production Engineer  Process, Product, Assignment or Lead
jobs.description:

Through our VisFlow platform, we also support structured development, operational visibility, compliance, and lifecycle governance across complex industrial environments.

Supporting automation, digitalization, Industry 4.0, and cost-reduction initiatives
Developing standardized production methods, documentation, instructions, and best practices
Collaborating with production, quality, maintenance, design, logistics, purchasing, and suppliers

Your Profile
We welcome experienced Production Engineers as well as senior specialists and technical leaders.
You likely have experience within one or more of the following areas:
Production engineering, manufacturing engineering, process engineering, or product engineering

Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented
Hands-on while able to maintain a strategic perspective

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Om tjänsten

Internationella Engelska Skolan Värmdö öppnade 2021 och har sedan dess byggt upp en stark skolkultur med tydliga rutiner, höga förväntningar och goda relationer mellan elever och personal. På IES Värmdö arbetar vi tillsammans för att skapa en trygg, lugn och positiv lärmiljö där elever ges bästa möjliga förutsättningar att utvecklas både kunskapsmässigt och socialt.

Skolan har idag cirka 610 elever i årskurs F–9 och omkring 65 medarbetare. Vi söker nu en engagerad och trygg elevassistent till lågstadiet som vill vara med och stötta en elev i skoldagen och bidra till en stabil och inkluderande lärmiljö.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som elevassistent arbetar du nära en elev under skoldagen och hjälper till att skapa förutsättningar för eleven att lyckas både socialt och kunskapsmässigt. Du stöttar eleven under lektioner, övergångar, raster och andra delar av skoldagen, och vid behov även under fritidsverksamheten.

Du blir en viktig vuxen i elevens vardag och samarbetar nära med lärare, fritidspersonal, elevhälsa och vårdnadshavare. Rollen kräver tålamod, flexibilitet och ett lugnt och tydligt bemötande. Du behöver kunna anpassa ditt stöd utifrån elevens behov samtidigt som du bidrar till struktur, trygghet och positiva relationer.

På IES Värmdö arbetar vi med gemensamma rutiner och ett nära samarbete mellan olika personalgrupper. Vi söker därför dig som tycker om att arbeta i team och som delar vår övertygelse om att tydlighet, relationer och höga förväntningar hjälper elever att lyckas.

Tjänsten är en visstidsanställning på 100 %.

Vi söker dig som:

- Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn eller ungdomar
- Har erfarenhet av eller intresse för att arbeta med elever med NPF eller andra behov av stöd
- Är lugn, ansvarstagande och lösningsfokuserad
- Har lätt för att skapa goda relationer med elever
- Är flexibel och kan anpassa ditt stöd utifrån situation och behov
- Tycker om att samarbeta och kommunicera med olika yrkesgrupper
- Har god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har:

- Erfarenhet av arbete i skola eller fritidshem
- Utbildning eller kurser inom exempelvis NPF, pedagogik, konflikthantering eller bemötande
- Erfarenhet av lågaffektivt bemötande eller arbete med extra anpassningar och särskilt stöd

Personliga egenskaper

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Vi söker dig som är trygg, lyhörd och har ett genuint engagemang för att stötta barn i deras utveckling. Du är en stabil vuxen som kan skapa förtroende och bidra till ett lugnt och positivt klimat omkring eleven.

Du behöver inte kunna allt från början, men vi söker någon som är villig att lära sig, samarbeta och vara en aktiv del av skolans arbete kring elevens utveckling och välmående.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

ECAD Tool Owner / EPLAN Specialist for a Global Engineering Environment in Linköping
Description
We are looking for a consultant to take overall responsibility for EPLAN within an international, technology-focused organisation. The assignment combines an understanding of electrical design with application management, user support and the development of working practices. You do not need to know every aspect from day one, but you should understand EPLAN and be able to drive initiatives in collaboration with users, IT and other technical teams.
About the assignment
As ECAD Tool Owner, you will have global responsibility for managing and further developing the EPLAN environment. The role combines technical and coordination responsibilities: gathering business requirements, leading discussions with key users and ensuring that tools, guidelines and integrations evolve in a structured way.
A key part of the assignment is the integration between EPLAN and Teamcenter via XPLM. You will take the lead on project activities related to this integration, including planning user testing and introducing the solution to different user groups. An electrical designer already provides backup support for administration and ongoing project activities, creating a solid foundation for handover and collaboration.
Your responsibilities will include:
Acting as the global administrator and Tool Owner for EPLAN.
Leading and developing the organisation’s key user community.
Gathering requirements, improvement suggestions and user feedback.
Planning and implementing EPLAN updates.
Creating and maintaining guidelines and shared working practices.
Managing licences and related application management activities.
Taking responsibility for the EPLAN infrastructure in collaboration with IT.
Supporting key users and helping resolve issues efficiently.
Taking ownership of the XPLM interface between EPLAN and Teamcenter.
Leading projects related to the further development and rollout of the integration.
Planning user testing and introducing new solutions to the relevant users.

Your profile
You have worked in electrical design and have practical experience with EPLAN. Your background may include roles such as electrical designer, EPLAN administrator, application specialist, CAD/ECAD coordinator or application manager. What matters most is that you understand users’ day-to-day work and can take clear ownership of tool-related matters.
You should be comfortable gathering requirements, coordinating activities and driving initiatives forward with multiple stakeholders. The role suits someone who is structured, communicative and solution-oriented, with the ability to move between technical details and a broader application management perspective.
Mandatory requirements
Experience in electrical design.
Practical experience with EPLAN.
Ability to gather requirements and plan and drive activities.
Strong communication skills in English, both spoken and written.

Desirable qualifications
Experience in EPLAN administration or application management.
Experience with Teamcenter.
Experience with XPLM or similar integrations between ECAD and PLM systems.
Experience with system upgrades, user testing or rollouts to multiple user groups.
Experience leading key user networks or working in an international organisation.

Assignment details
Assignment type: Consultancy assignment
Workload: Full-time, 100%
Location: Linköping, on-site
Start date: As soon as possible
Assignment duration: Six-month periods
Extension: Good prospects for extension
Language: Spoken and written English required
Why this assignment is interesting
This role offers significant practical influence over a core engineering design tool within a global technology organisation. You will work closely with electrical design teams, users and IT while driving an important integration between ECAD and PLM. The combination of technical depth, international collaboration and clear ownership makes this assignment particularly relevant for a consultant looking to move from a dedicated design role into tool ownership and technical application management.

jobs.occupation: Master Thesis: Methane removal from ventilation air at Henriksdal
jobs.description:
Methane is a strong greenhouse gas which is 28 times more potent than carbon dioxide. Methane is formed by microorganisms as a result of anaerobic transformation of organic matter. In wastewater handling, anaerobic conditions prevail in wastewater network, during the first wastewater treatment steps and in sludge handling processes at wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs). In order to limit methane emissions, an intensive work is being done to find biogas leaks and to destruct the methane in ventilation air. However, some ventilation streams have methane content significantly lower than 2 000 ppm, which is the lower limit for destruction using existing matured technologies. Direct methane emissions at Henriksdal WWTP stand for around 40% of all the climate impact of wastewater treatment and can be lowered if a suitable method for methane destruction be found and implemented.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
In the proposed project several alternatives of methane destruction will be tested experimentally. Biological trickling filters can be used for aerobic degradation of methane and it was demonstrated that the conversion rate can be significantly increased by applying a mixture of water and silicon oil as the liquid medium compared with using only water (Lebrero et al. 2015). It is planned to operate two trickling filters within the project, one with water and one with two-liquid medium, and treat real ventilation air from methane at Henriksdal WWTP. Methane and hydrogen sulphide reduction will be monitored. Moreover, chemical analysis of the liquid medium for nitrogen and phosphorus species will be performed regularly.

Another opportunity which will be explored is using the polluted air for aeration in the biological treatment step of the wastewater treatment process. This possibility will be explored in lab or pilot scale.

Two other possibilities, which will most probably be investigated only theoretically, is concentration by gas membranes and destruction in a membrane aerated biological reactor.

This Thesis project is experimentally oriented and big part of the work will include running experiments and performing chemical analyses. The Master Thesis project is to be performed during the spring term 2027 (30 hp).

KVALIFIKATIONER
To be eligible for this thesis project, you should be enrolled in a program within chemistry, environmental engineering, water engineering, or another relevant field of study.

Most of the work will be performed at Henriksdals reningsverk (Värmdövägen 23, Stockholm). Daily attendance is required.

Industrial supervisor: Andriy Malovanyy, andriy.malovanyy@svoa.se (SVOA).

Practical help: Gabriel Persson (SVOA).

This specific project is intended solely for students planning to conduct their thesis during the spring term 2027.  However, if you are interested in doing a thesis project with us during the autumn semester of 2027, there may be opportunities closer to that time.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.

The applicants are invited to send a short motivation letter (do not use AI !), a CV, and a transcript of records from education on university level with name of the courses and grades for those. The application can be done in English or Swedish. The Thesis can be written in either English or Swedish. The last day to apply is 15th of Dec 2025. Candidate selection is done continuously and will most probably be finalized in November. In line with SVOA policy, a successfully completed Master's project is rewarded with a compensation of 1 000 SEK (pre-tax) for every hp of the project (30 000 kr for a 30 hp project).

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Lärare i matematik 7-9 IES Österåker öppnade i augusti 2024 och är en modern F–9-skola med höga ambitioner.När skolan är fullt utbyggd kommer den att ha cirka 600 elever, fördelade på två klasser per årskurs.

Vi följer den svenska läroplanen och har möjlighet att bedriva upp till 50 procent av undervisningen på engelska. Vår verksamhet bygger på tydliga rutiner, höga förväntningar och en trygg lärmiljö där både elever och medarbetare ges möjlighet att utvecklas och lyckas.

Skolan ligger centralt i Åkersberga, cirka 30 minuter från Stockholm. Vårt campus består av både nybyggda och renoverade lokaler och har nära tillgång till idrottsanläggningar, natur och Stockholms skärgård.

Vi söker nu en erfaren och behörig matematiklärare för årskurs 7–9 som vill bli en del av vårt team.

Om tjänsten

Som lärare ansvarar du för att planera, genomföra, bedöma och följa upp elevernas lärande i matematik. Du hjälper eleverna att utveckla tilltro till sin egen förmåga, stärka sina problemlösningsstrategier och nå goda kunskapsresultat.

En viktig del av uppdraget är att möta elever med olika behov och förutsättningar. Du behöver kunna ge stöd till elever som har utmaningar i matematik, samtidigt som du erbjuder fördjupning och ytterligare utmaningar till elever som behöver utvecklas vidare.

Det finns även möjlighet att undervisa i IGCSE Mathematics i årskurs 9 för den som är intresserad och har relevant erfarenhet eller kompetens.

I tjänsten ingår mentorskap för en grupp elever samt ett nära samarbete med vårdnadshavare, kollegor, elevhälsoteamet och skolledningen för att skapa bästa möjliga förutsättningar för elevernas utveckling och lärande.

Vi söker dig som:

- Har en giltig lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa i matematik för årskurs 7–9.
- Behärskar både svenska och engelska obehindrat.
- Kan undervisa i matematik på både svenska och engelska med god säkerhet.
- Har flera års dokumenterad erfarenhet av framgångsrik undervisning.
- Har god förmåga att hjälpa elever som har svårt med matematik att utvecklas och nå sina mål.
- Har erfarenhet av att stödja och utmana elever med hög måluppfyllelse och goda ämneskunskaper.
- Har erfarenhet av eller kunskap om IGCSE Mathematics. Detta är meriterande men inget krav.
- Skapar en lugn, strukturerad och positiv lärmiljö.
- Har höga förväntningar på alla elever och tror på varje elevs förmåga att utvecklas.
- Samarbetar väl med kollegor och trivs med att arbeta i team.
- Ger tydlig och utvecklande återkoppling som hjälper eleverna att komma vidare i sitt lärande.

Vi erbjuder:

- En skola med tydliga rutiner och ett närvarande och engagerat ledarskap.
- Stöttande och engagerade kollegor.
- En internationell arbetsmiljö.
- Möjlighet att vara med och bygga upp och utveckla en växande skola.
- En verksamhetskultur med fokus på lärande, respekt och goda kunskapsresultat.

Anställningsvillkor

Tjänsten är på 100 procent. Sex månaders provanställning tillämpas.

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag.

Utdrag ur belastningsregistret ska uppvisas före anställning.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och forma framtidens första steg i lärandet?

Vi söker en legitimerad lärare F–3 med behörighet att undervisa i förskoleklass – en nyckelroll i elevernas livslånga läranderesa. I ljuset av den kommande läroplanen 2028 utvecklar vi undervisning som sätter elevens nyfikenhet, språk- och matematikutveckling samt utforskande arbetssätt i centrum.

Internationella Engelska Skolan har i över 30 år haft en positiv inverkan på sina elevers utveckling. Vi är övertygade om att detta framgångsrika resultat kommer från vårt starka etos, där engagerade och närvarande ledare skapar en miljö där alla strävar mot gemensamma mål. Hos oss får lärarna fokus på det viktigaste – undervisning och lärande. Eleverna är alltid i centrum, och alla elever är dina elever. Vi tror på värderingar som grund för framgång, och samarbete är en självklar del av vårt sätt att arbeta.

Som lärare i förskoleklass planerar, genomför och utvärderar du undervisningen i nära samarbete med kollegor och i linje med skolans styrdokument. Du arbetar med Skolverkets kartläggningsmaterial Hitta språket och Hitta matematiken som en del av ett systematiskt och framåtsyftande kvalitetsarbete.

Hos oss skapar du inspirerande lärmiljöer där lek, kreativitet och praktiskt lärande är centrala verktyg – i linje med läroplanens ökade fokus på elevaktivt lärande och helhetsförståelse. Du följer elevernas utveckling genom att dokumentera, analysera och anpassa undervisningen för att ge varje elev bästa möjliga förutsättningar att lyckas.

På IES Kungsbacka bygger vi en skola där varje elev ges möjlighet att nå sin fulla potential – kunskapsmässigt, socialt och personligt. Vi värdesätter mångfald och ser elevernas olika erfarenheter, språk och perspektiv som en tillgång i undervisningen.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat lärarlag där det finns avsatt tid för kollegialt lärande, pedagogisk utveckling och att tillsammans utforska framtidens undervisning. I förskoleklassen samarbetar svensk- och engelsktalande lärare, vilket skapar en dynamisk och internationell lärmiljö.

 Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad grundlärare med behörighet för förskoleklass och som vill vara med och utveckla undervisning i takt med framtidens krav och möjligheter.

Du har en positiv människosyn och bygger förtroendefulla relationer med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare. Du motiverar och engagerar elever genom tydlig kommunikation och ett inkluderande arbetssätt, och du ser styrkan i att undervisa i en flerspråkig och mångkulturell miljö.

Du uttrycker dig väl i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska och använder digitala verktyg som en naturlig del av undervisningen – i linje med läroplanens fokus på digital kompetens och framtidsfärdigheter.

Vi söker en lagspelare som drivs av skolutveckling och som vill bidra till en undervisning där elever inte bara lär – utan växer, utforskar och utvecklar förmågor de bär med sig in i framtiden. 

Är du redo att göra skillnad – redan från första skoldagen?

Välkommen med din ansökan!
